prompt: Round 3 of 6. The researcher side proposes (We accept the 18-month exclusivity in the agreed field as a trade, but we need university ownership with an option t

content.text: The researcher wants uni_owns_option_to_licence with 30-day review. I need company ownership for embedding in products. I could move to uni_owns_option_to_assign (which gives us an option to take over the IP) and meet them halfway on review days (45... but only 0,30,60,90 are allowed). I'll accept 30 days on publication as a trade to get uni_owns_option_to_assign.
